run.name: Molina Healthcare, Inc.

run.summary: Molina is a deteriorating credit with adequate near-term liquidity: debt of USD 3,771 million is 11.32x EBITDA for the twelve months to September 30, 2026, against 1.54x in FY2024, with no principal due before June 2028. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is MOLINA HEALTHCARE, INC..

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (operating income + D&A), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 3,771; LTM EBITDA 333 (calculated, includes the 93 impairment; 8.85x total debt if it is added back); parent cash and investments 608. On consolidated cash and equivalents of 4,479 net debt is negative. Covenant EBITDA is not supplied.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA 976 (calculated) over cash paid for interest of 181 (10-K page:107). Expense basis: 5.08x on interest expense of 192.

cash.basis: Cash. Consolidated cash and equivalents (10-Q Q3 page:2); capacity per 10-Q Q3 page:40. Parent cash and investments 608. Consolidated cash is subject to statutory capital rules; investments of 4,100 are excluded from Cash. Revolver terminates November 20, 2030.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant headroom cannot be verified because the covenant definitions and reported ratios are not supplied, and EBITDA is calculated rather than reported.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is calculated, not reported, and cash interest and the covenant ratio are not available for the latest twelve months.
